response.sql:
WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS FLOAT) / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value
  FROM group_averages
),
after_first_filter AS (
  SELECT avg_ratio
  FROM group_averages
  WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT value FROM first_mean)
),
second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value
  FROM after_first_filter
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT avg_ratio
  FROM after_first_filter
  WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT value FROM second_mean)
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_remaining,
  AVG(avg_ratio - (SELECT value FROM first_mean)) AS avg_excess_first,
  AVG(avg_ratio - (SELECT value FROM second_mean)) AS avg_excess_second
FROM final_result

assumptions.assumption: GPT must be non-zero to avoid division by zero when computing the CPK ÷ GPT ratio; tests with GPT = 0 are excluded
Float division (via CAST to FLOAT) is required to return decimal ratios rather than truncated integers
